label: Actual grounding quantitative omission and nonvacuity controls
paraphrase: Closed mathematical controls on Unit-world Nat candidates, all actual and concrete. One fixed reverse-successor graph fails Nat ranking and selected-world foundation. S=0 with epsilon=0 omits positivity; S n=-n with epsilon=1 omits any lower bound; S=0 with epsilon=1 omits edge gap. Each retains the other two inputs. On the same graph S n=1/(n+1) is lower-bounded and has strictly positive edge increases toward effects, yet no positive uniform epsilon. An infinite ascending Nat graph with S n=n, L=0, epsilon=1 jointly satisfies all inputs, has edge 0 to 1 and admits the constructed finite rank. No actual metaphysical interpretation is asserted.
